mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increased by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the unemployment rate decreased by more than 0.3 percentage points within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP by more than 2% over the previous quarter signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the quarters where real GDP increased by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% over the previous month signals increased economic activity and corporate output, which boosts investor confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 70% of the months where industrial production increased by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a strengthening economy, boosting consumer confidence and spending, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate coupled with a decrease in the consumer price index signals a reduction in inflationary pressures and easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.1% and CPIAUCSL decreases > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 jobs in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the months where nonfarm payrolls increased by more than 200,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures by more than 1% over the previous month signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the months where real personal consumption expenditures increased by more than 1%.
